core_obligations: Read the square as a pullback of localizations (proof lines 4665-4670): the author identifies the localizations at the four objects using the cartesian square, so that the two composites act on the same category.

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves base change for the direct image along a cartesian square in a site, identifying the restriction of the direct image with the direct image of the restriction along the localized morphisms (statement lines 4651-4663, with the Xy-pic square delivered verbatim). The proof identifies the localizations involved using the cartesian square (proof lines 4665-4670) and then compares the two composites through the description of the direct image on a localized site (proof lines 4670-4674). The non-formal content is the identification of the two localizations. The claim is H2: one identification plus one comparison.
